findings.explanation: Outside the domain, Lean returns ARB, so `FAPPLY FEMPTY x = ARB` holds by rfl (and equals HD [], which is also ARB). HOL4 defines FAPPLY f x = OUTL (fmap_REP f x). For x not in FDOM f, this is OUTL (INR ()). OUTL (sumScript.sml:286) is specified only by OUTL (INL x) = x. ARB is an unconstrained constant (boolScript.sml:245). The saved theorem NOT_FDOM_FAPPLY_FEMPTY only gives f ' x = FEMPTY ' x, so `FEMPTY ' x = ARB` is left open. Lean therefore proves a specific equation about FAPPLY outside its specification. Values inside the domain agree.
findings.repair:
opaque FAPPLY_undef {β : Type v} [Nonempty β] : β

def FAPPLY {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Nonempty β] (f : FMap α β) (x : α) : β :=
  match f.1 x with
  | some v => v
  | none => FAPPLY_undef
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.FMap

example {α β : Type} [Nonempty β] (x : α) : FAPPLY (FEMPTY : FMap α β) x = ARB := rfl
findings.hol4_check: (!x:'a. (FEMPTY:'a |-> num) ' x = OUTL (INR () : num + one)) /\ (?f:num + one -> num. (!n. f (INL n) = n) /\ f (INR ()) <> ARB)
